## What this describes

These definitions describe the **OMOP CDM v5.4** schema as defined in the dbt models, not the contents of any one released dataset. Individual released datasets (de-identified, limited, full) share this schema but differ in which rows and values they contain.

| | |
|---|---|
| Data model | OMOP CDM v5.4 |
| Source repository | https://github.com/susom/starr-data-lake.git |
| Source branch | main |

| Source commit date | 2026-08-20 |
| Source path | dbt/omop_cdm54/models/baseline |
| Generated by | scripts/generate_exports.py |
| Tables | 43 |
| Fields | 504 |

No field has been added, retyped or dropped since 2026-08-20.

### Columns

| | |
|---|---|
| **Table** | Table the field belongs to. Links to that table's fields. |
| **Category** | Core CDM or Stanford extension (underscore-prefixed tables are Stanford additions). |
| **Field** | Column name as defined in the dbt model. |
| **Required** | Yes when dbt declares the column a primary key or not null. |
| **Type** | BigQuery data type, canonicalised to a single spelling. |
| **References** | Tables this field is declared a foreign key to, from the dbt model's constraints. Blank means no foreign key is declared — not necessarily that none exists. |
| **Fields** | Number of fields in the table. |
| **Description** | Description from the dbt model. |

:::

For what each table is for and how Stanford populates it, see [OMOP CDM v5.4 Data Model](omop_data_model.qmd). The fields are here; the narrative is there.

<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">care_site_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>

<td>Unique identifier for each care site.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#care_site">CARE_SITE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">care_site_name</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The name of the care site as it appears in the source data. This field is used to identify the specific name or title associated with the care site, formatted as &quot;Care Site Name | Department Specialty.&quot; Examples of typical entries include: - &quot;EHC PHARMACY | PHARMACY&quot; - &quot;INFUSION TREATMENT CENTER-SNHC | INFUSION&quot; - &quot;RADIATION THERAPY SPLTY | RADIATION ONCOLOGY&quot; This format combines the department name with its specialty.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#care_site">CARE_SITE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">place_of_service_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field summarizes the typical type of care provided at the site. Examples include Inpatient Hospital (ID: 8717), which covers overnight facilities like Stanford Hospital; Skilled Nursing Facility (ID: 8863), providing rehabilitative and nursing care; Outpatient Hospital on Campus (ID: 8756), representing campus-based outpatient services; Mass Immunization Center (ID: 8858), for mass vaccination programs; Home (ID: 0), representing healthcare in a patient’s residence; and Office (ID: 0), which refers to office-based outpatient care like physician offices Typically, if a care site provides multiple levels of care, assign the `place_of_service_concept_id` that represents the primary or most frequent type of care. For example, if most visits to a care site are inpatient, the `place_of_service_concept_id` should represent &quot;Inpatient Hospital.&quot; The VISIT_OCCURRENCE table can further refine specific settings for individual visits.</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td class="dd-mono">location_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The location_id from the LOCATION table representing the physical location of the care site. This ID connects to the LOCATION table to capture the exact address or physical space associated with the care site.</td>
</tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_class">CONCEPT_CLASS</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">concept_class_name</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The name describing the Concept Class, e.g. Clinical Finding, Ingredient, etc.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_class">CONCEPT_CLASS</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">concept_class_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>An identifier for the concept that represents the Concept Class. The concept_class_concept_id is a foreign key to the CONCEPT table.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_relationship">CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">concept_id_1</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the CONCEPT table indicating the first Concept in the relationship.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_relationship">CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">concept_id_2</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the CONCEPT table indicating the second Concept in the relationship.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_relationship">CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">relationship_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#relationship">RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the RELATIONSHIP table indicating the type of relationship between concept_id_1 and concept_id_2. It contains an alphanumerical identifier, that can also be used as the abbreviation of the Relationship. The relationship_id defines the nature of the relationship, such as &#x27;is a&#x27;, &#x27;maps to&#x27;, &#x27;related to&#x27;, etc.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_relationship">CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">valid_start_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date when the Relationship was first recorded. The default value is 1-Jan-1970, meaning the Concept has no (known) date of inception.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_relationship">CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">valid_end_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date when the Relationship is invalidated. The default value is 31-Dec-2099, meaning the Relationship is valid until it becomes deprecated.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_relationship">CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">invalid_reason</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Reason the Concept was invalidated. Possible values are D (deleted), U (replaced with an update), or NULL (when the valid_end_date is the default value).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_synonym">CONCEPT_SYNONYM</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the CONCEPT table indicating the Concept to which the synonym belongs.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_synonym">CONCEPT_SYNONYM</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">concept_synonym_name</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Name of the synonym for the Concept.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept_synonym">CONCEPT_SYNONYM</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">language_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>Foreign key to the CONCEPT table indicating the language to which the Concept Synonym belongs.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_era">CONDITION_ERA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_era_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The unique identifier for each condition era.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_era">CONDITION_ERA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">person_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the person_id in the person table for whom the condition era is recorded.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_era">CONDITION_ERA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the standard concept_id in the concept table for the condition recorded.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_era">CONDITION_ERA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_era_start_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The start date of the condition era.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_era">CONDITION_ERA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_era_end_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The end date of the condition era.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_era">CONDITION_ERA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_occurrence_count</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The number of condition occurrences that contributed to this condition era.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_occurrence_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The unique key given to each OMOP condition occurrence record. In STARR-OMOP, this ID is currently NOT stable across releases, so the same condition occurrence will likely have a different ID from one STARR-OMOP release to the next.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">person_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#person">PERSON</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the person_id in the person table for whom the condition is recorded.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the standard concept_id in the concept table for the condition recorded. This field is recommended for primary use in analyses and must be used for network studies. Only records whose source values map to concepts with a domain of &#x27;Condition&#x27; (or unmapped concepts, aka &#x27;0&#x27; condition-concept_id) are allowed in this table.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_start_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date when the condition was recorded. For problem list entries, this is the date the condition was first noted by the patient, or first entered into the problem list if the noted date is not available. See the condition_type_concept_id to identify the record provenance.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_start_datetime</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATETIME</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date and time when the condition was recorded. For problem list entries, this is the date and time the condition was first noted by the patient, or first entered into the problem list if the noted date and time is not available. See the condition_type_concept_id to identify the record provenance.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_end_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date when the condition was resolved or removed from the problem list. This field is null for all condition records that did not originate from the problem list (aka billing or encounter diagnoses). See the condition_type_concept_id to identify the record provenance.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_end_datetime</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATETIME</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date and time when the condition was resolved or removed from the problem list. This field is null for all condition records that did not originate from the problem list (aka billing or encounter diagnoses). See the condition_type_concept_id to identify the record provenance.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_type_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the standard concept_id in the concept table for the provenance of the condition record, such as &#x27;EHR billing record&#x27;, &#x27;EHR encounter record&#x27;, or &#x27;EHR problem list&#x27;.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_status_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the standard concept_id in the concept table for the status of the condition record, such as &#x27;primary diagnosis&#x27; or &#x27;admission diagnosis&#x27;, where available.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">stop_reason</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The reason the condition is no longer valid. This information is unavailable in our EHR and this field is therefore null for all of STARR-OMOP.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">provider_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#provider">PROVIDER</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the provider_id in the provider table for the provider associated with the condition record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">visit_occurrence_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#visit_occurrence">VISIT_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the visit_occurrence_id in the visit_occurrence table for the visit during which the condition was recorded.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">visit_detail_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#visit_detail">VISIT_DETAIL</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the visit_detail_id in the visit_detail table for the visit detail during which the condition was recorded. This field is currently not populated in STARR-OMOP.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The verbatim value of the original condition information as it appears in the source data. In STARR-OMOP, this contains the dx_id (internal identifier), dx_name (description of the condition), and the ICD-9-CM or ICD-10-CM code(s) associated with that dx_id, separated by pipes. Note that there may be multiple ICD codes listed, in which case they will be separated by commas Example: &quot;12345 | Uncontrolled type 2 diabetes mellitus with microalbuminuria, with long-term current use of insulin | E11.29, E11.65, R80.9, Z79.4&quot;</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the concept_id in the concept table for the condition as it appears in the source data. In STARR-OMOP, this field contains the concept_id corresponding to the ICD-9-CM or ICD-10-CM code associated with the condition if available. There will be one row per individual ICD-9-CM or ICD-10-CM code listed in the condition_source_value as described above.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#condition_occurrence">CONDITION_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">condition_status_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The verbatim value of the original condition status information as it appears in the source data. In STARR-OMOP, this field is derived from a combination of the primary_dx flag and the source table name, and is not available for all records.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">cost_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A unique identifier for each cost record. One cost record is generated for each response by a payer. In a claims databases, the payment and payment terms reported by the payer for the goods or services billed will generate one cost record. If the source data has payment information for more than one payer (i.e. primary insurance and secondary insurance payment for one entity), then a cost record is created for each reporting payer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">cost_event_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the event for which cost is recorded. This could be a procedure, drug exposure, visit, device exposure, measurement, observation, or other event.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">cost_domain_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined domain identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the type of domain to which the cost record belongs.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">cost_type_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the type of cost, such as charge, payment, or adjustment.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">currency_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the currency, such as USD, EUR, etc.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">total_charge</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Overall total amount charged for the services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">total_cost</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Overall total cost of services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">total_paid</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Overall total amount paid for the services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_by_payer</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total amount contributed and/or reimbursed by the payer for the services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_by_patient</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total amount paid by the patient for the services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_patient_copay</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total copay amount (fixed amount paid by the patient) for the services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_patient_coinsurance</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total coinsurance (percentage of total medical cost covered by the patient - applicable only once patient has reached their deductible amount) for the services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_patient_deductible</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total deductible (upfront payment by patient before payer starts covering medical costs) associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_by_primary</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total amount paid by patient&#x27;s primary payer for services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_ingredient_cost</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total amount charged by the wholesale distributor or manufacturer if cost record reflects a drug cost.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">paid_dispensing_fee</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total amount charged by the pharmacy and the sales tax if cost record reflects a drug cost.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">payer_plan_period_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the payer_plan_period table.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">amount_allowed</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Total amount allowed by the payer for services associated with the cost record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">revenue_code_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>

<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#cost">COST</a></td>

<td>A foreign key to the Person table. The ID of the Person for whom this death record belongs. This field serves as the de facto primary key for the table (validated via dbt `unique` and `not_null` data tests, as the OMOP CDM does not define a formal primary key for the DEATH table), since only one record per person_id is allowed.</td>

<td>Shows the provenance of the record - e.g. &#x27;EHR Administration&#x27;, &#x27;EHR Order&#x27;, &#x27;Patient Reported&#x27; or &#x27;EHR Dispense&#x27;</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">stop_reason</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The reason a person stopped a medication as it is represented in the source. Reasons include regimen completed, changed, removed, etc.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">refills</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is filled in for prescriptions only and represents the number of refills at the time of prescription.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">quantity</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The amount of drug received.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">days_supply</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Days supply as found in the source data. If there is no days supply then this is left blank.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">sig</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Verbatim instructions for the drug as given by the provider</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">route_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The standard CONCEPT_ID that the ROUTE_SOURCE_VALUE maps to in the route domain</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">lot_number</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Lot number</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">provider_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The Provider associated with drug record, e.g. the provider who wrote the prescription or the provider who administered the drug.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">visit_occurrence_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The Visit during which the drug was prescribed, administered or dispensed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">visit_detail_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The VISIT_DETAIL record during which the drug exposure occurred. For example, if the person was in the ICU at the time of the drug administration the VISIT_OCCURRENCE record would reflect the overall hospital stay and the VISIT_DETAIL record would reflect the ICU stay during the hospital visit.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">drug_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field houses the verbatim value from the source data representing the drug exposure that occurred. In this case it is the in-house shc or lpch medication_id, not RxNorm code.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">drug_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is the concept representing the drug source value and may not necessarily be standard.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">route_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field houses the verbatim value from the source data representing the drug route.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_exposure">DRUG_EXPOSURE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">dose_unit_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field houses the verbatim value from the source data representing the dose unit of the drug given.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">drug_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>Foreign key to the concept_id in CONCEPT table representing the Branded Drug or Clinical Drug Product.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">ingredient_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>Foreign key to the concept_id in CONCEPT table representing the active ingredient contained within the drug product. Note that Combination Drugs will have more than one record in this table, one for each active Ingredient.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">amount_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The numeric value or the amount of active ingredient contained within the drug product.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">amount_unit_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the concept_id in the CONCEPT table representing the Unit of measure for the amount of active ingredient contained within the drug product.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">numerator_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The concentration of the active ingredient contained within the drug product.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">numerator_unit_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the concept_id in the CONCEPT table representing the Unit of measure for the concentration of active ingredient.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">denominator_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The amount of total liquid (or other divisible product, such as ointment, gel, spray, etc.).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">denominator_unit_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the concept_id in the CONCEPT table representing the representing the denominator unit for the concentration of active ingredient.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">box_size</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The number of units of Clinical Branded Drug or Quantified Clinical or Branded Drug contained in a box as dispensed to the patient.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">valid_start_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date when the Concept was first recorded. The default value is 1-Jan-1970, meaning the Concept has no (known) date of inception.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">valid_end_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date when the Concept became invalid because it was deleted or superseded (updated) by a new concept. The default value is 31-Dec-2099, meaning the Concept is valid until it becomes deprecated.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#drug_strength">DRUG_STRENGTH</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">invalid_reason</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Reason the Concept was invalidated. Possible values are D (deleted), U (replaced with an update) or NULL when valid_end_date has the default value.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A unique identifier for each episode.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">person_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the person table for each episode record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the episode.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_start_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The start date of the episode.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_start_datetime</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATETIME</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The start date and time of the episode.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_end_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The end date of the episode. If the episode is ongoing, this field can be NULL.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_end_datetime</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATETIME</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The end date and time of the episode. If the episode is ongoing, this field can be NULL.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_parent_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>An identifier to the parent episode within which this episode occurs. This creates a hierarchical structure of episodes. This field is currently not populated in STARR-OMOP.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_number</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A number representing the order of occurrence of the episode within an individual person. This field is currently not populated in STARR-OMOP.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_object_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the disease phase, outcome, or other abstraction of which the episode consists. This field is currently set to 0 for all rows in STARR-OMOP.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_type_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the type of episode.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The source code for the episode as it appears in the source data.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the source value of the episode. This field is currently set to 0 for all rows in STARR-OMOP.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode_event">EPISODE_EVENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode">EPISODE</a></td>
<td>A unique identifier for the episode to which this event belongs.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode_event">EPISODE_EVENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">event_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field is the primary key of the linked record in the database. For example, if the Episode Event is a Condition Occurrence, then the CONDITION_OCCURRENCE_ID of the linked record goes in this field.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#episode_event">EPISODE_EVENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">episode_event_field_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the Standardized Vocabularies that identifies the table and/or field that the event_id (primary key of the linked event record) came from.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#fact_relationship">FACT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">domain_concept_id_1</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>The concept representing the domain of fact 1, from which the corresponding table and field can be inferred. This field identifies which field fact_id_1 originates from (e.g., measurement.measurement_id, person.person_id). Join to the concept table to retrieve the name and other information about the concept.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#fact_relationship">FACT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">fact_id_1</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The unique identifier for fact 1. Use domain_concept_id_1 to determine which table and field this ID originates from (e.g., measurement_id from measurement table). This field can then be joined to that table to retrieve more information about the fact.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#fact_relationship">FACT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">domain_concept_id_2</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>The concept representing the domain of fact 2, from which the corresponding table and field can be inferred. This field identifies which field fact_id_2 originates from (e.g., measurement.measurement_id, person.person_id). Join to the concept table to retrieve the name and other information about the concept.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#fact_relationship">FACT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">fact_id_2</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The unique identifier for fact 2. Use domain_concept_id_2 to determine which table and field this ID originates from (e.g., measurement_id from measurement table). This field can then be joined to that table to retrieve more information about the fact.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#fact_relationship">FACT_RELATIONSHIP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">relationship_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the relationship between fact 1 and fact 2. Examples include &#x27;systolic to diastolic&#x27;, &#x27;diastolic to systolic&#x27;, &#x27;parent to child&#x27;, &#x27;child to parent&#x27;.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">image_occurrence_id</td>

<td>Core CDM</td>

<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>

<tr>

<td class="dd-mono">procedure_occurrence_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the OMOP procedure_occurrence table.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">visit_occurrence_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the OMOP visit_occurrence table</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">anatomic_site_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Text description of the part of the body examined as appears in the source DICOM metadata.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">wadors_uri</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A Web Access to DICOM Objects.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">local_path</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Local path to DICOM Object.</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>

<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>

<td class="dd-mono">_series_description</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Series description as it appears in the DICOM metadata</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">_note_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#image_occurrence">IMAGE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>

<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>

<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>

<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>

<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>

<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>

<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">zip</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The 5-digit zip code of the address.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">county</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The county of the address.</td>
</tr>

<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">location_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The verbatim value for the location as it shows up in the source.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">country_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The verbatim value for the country as it shows up in the source.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">country_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The standard concept ID representing the country. Join to the concept table for more information.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">latitude</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The latitude of the location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">longitude</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The longitude of the location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#location">LOCATION</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">_census_block_group</td>

<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>

<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">person_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#person">PERSON</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the person in the person table who is the subject of the visit.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>This is the field recommended for primary use in analyses, and must be used for network studies. This is the standard concept mapped from the measurement_source value which represents a measurement</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date of the measurement</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_datetime</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATETIME</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is the datetime of the measurement. If time is not available the convention is to set the time to midnight (00:00:0000).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_time</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is present for backwards compatibility and will be deprecated in an upcoming OMOP-CDM version. Is it set to NULL for STARR-OMOP</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_type_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>This field can be used to determine the provenance of the Measurement record, as in whether the measurement was from an EHR system, insurance claim, registry, or other sources. For STARR-OMOP, it is set to EHR record (concept_id=32817)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">operator_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>Operators are &lt;, &lt;=, =, &gt;=, &gt; and these concepts belong to the &#x27;Meas Value Operator&#x27; domain. This is intended for measurments that are ranges and it is not expected to be populated for most measurements.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">value_as_number</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is the numerical value of the Result of the Measurement, if available. Note that measurements such as blood pressures will be split into their component parts i.e. one record for systolic, one record for diastolic. The relationship for the two records (systolic/diastolic) is captured in the FACT_RELATIONSHIP table.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">value_as_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>If the raw data gives a categorial result for measurements those values are captured and mapped to standard concepts in the [&#x27;Meas Value&#x27;](https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?domain=Meas+Value&amp;invalidReason=Valid&amp;standardConcept=Standard) domain. (e.g. &#x27;normal&#x27;, &#x27;abnormal&#x27;, &#x27;positive&#x27;, &#x27;negative&#x27;, &#x27;detected&#x27;, &#x27;not detected&#x27;, etc.)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">unit_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>This concept represents the mapping of the UNIT_SOURCE_VALUE column. It is mapped to the [Unit](https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?domain=Unit&amp;invalidReason=Valid&amp;standardConcept=Standard) domain that best represents the unit as given in the source data</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">range_low</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This represent the lower bound of the range of the value_as_number as presented in the source date. This data is not always available. Ranges have the same unit as the VALUE_AS_NUMBER. These ranges are provided by the source and will remain NULL if not given.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">range_high</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This represent the upper bound of the range of the value_as_number as presented in the source date. This data is not always available. Ranges have the same unit as the VALUE_AS_NUMBER. These ranges are provided by the source and will remain NULL if not given.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">provider_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#provider">PROVIDER</a></td>
<td>The provider associated with measurement record, e.g. the provider who ordered the test or the provider who recorded the result.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">visit_occurrence_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#visit_occurrence">VISIT_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>The encounter in which the Measurement occurred.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">visit_detail_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#visit_detail">VISIT_DETAIL</a></td>
<td>The VISIT_DETAIL record during which the Measurement occurred. For example, if the Person was in the ICU at the time the VISIT_OCCURRENCE record would reflect the overall hospital stay and the VISIT_DETAIL record would reflect the ICU stay during the hospital visit.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field contains the exact value from the source data that represents the measurement that occurred. TODO: Update with more information about the column used.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>This is the concept representing the MEASUREMENT_SOURCE_VALUE and may not necessarily be standard.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">unit_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field contains the exact value from the source data that represents the unit of measurement used.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">unit_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>This is the concept representing the UNIT_SOURCE_VALUE and may not necessarily be standard.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">value_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This field houses the verbatim result value of the Measurement from the source data. This includes numbers (e.g. 5.6), text (e.g. &#x27;normal&#x27;), etc.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">measurement_event_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>If the Measurement record is related to another record in the database, this field is the primary key of the linked record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#measurement">MEASUREMENT</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">meas_event_field_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>If the Measurement record is related to another record in the database, this field is the CONCEPT_ID that identifies which table the primary key of the linked record came from.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">metadata_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">Yes</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The primary key for Metadata table, auto-incremented. At this moment there is a single row in this table so the metadata_id is populated with the number 0.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">metadata_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the metadata record in question. For example, the concept_id 705800 which represents the metadata concept &#x27;OMOP CDM version 5.4.2&#x27; is populated here.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">metadata_type_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the type concept for the metadata record in question.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">name</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The concept_name for the metadata_concept_id representing the metadata record.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">value_as_string</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is the string value of the result of the Metadata, if applicable and available. It is not expected that all Metadata will have string results, rather, this field is here to house values should they exist.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">value_as_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies representing the concept_id mapping for result of the Metadata, if applicable and available.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">value_as_number</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">FLOAT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is the numeric value of the result of the Metadata, if applicable and available. It is not expected that all Metadata will have numeric results, rather, this field is here to house values should they exist.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">metadata_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The date when the metadata record was added to the dataset.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#metadata">METADATA</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">metadata_datetime</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATETIME</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>The datetime when the metadata record was added to the dataset.</td>
</tr>

<td class="dd-mono">term_exists</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Term_exists is defined as a flag that indicates if the patient actually has or had the condition. Any of the following modifiers would make Term_exists false - Negation = true Subject = [anything other than the patient] Conditional = true/li&gt; Rule_out = true Uncertain = very low certainty or any lower certainties. A complete lack of modifiers would make Term_exists true.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#note_nlp">NOTE_NLP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">term_temporal</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Term_temporal is to indicate if a condition is present or just in the past. The following would be past - History = true Concept_date = anything before the time of the report).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#note_nlp">NOTE_NLP</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">term_modifiers</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Various modification qualifiers for the term. Negation = false Subject = patient Conditional = false Rule_out = false Uncertain = true or high or moderate or even low (could argue about low). Term_modifiers will concatenate all modifiers for different types of entities (conditions, drugs, labs etc) into one string. Lab values will be saved as one of the modifiers.</td>
</tr>

<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>

<td>The date on which the observation period for the person ends. This is calculated as the earliest of the following three dates: 1) patient&#x27;s death date + 60 day grace period, 2) source data cut date, 3) date of the latest clinical event recorded for the person in the OMOP CDM tables visit_occurrence, condition_occurrence, procedure_occurrence, measurement, drug_exposure, device_exposure, and observation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td class="dd-mono">period_type_concept_id</td>

<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to a standard concept_id in the concept table for the type of observation period. In STARR-OMOP, this is set to 32882, &#x27;Standard algorithm from EHR&#x27;.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#payer_plan_period">PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD</a></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#payer_plan_period">PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD</a></td>

<td class="dd-mono">person_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>

<tr>

<td class="dd-mono">payer_plan_period_start_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Start date of the plan coverage described in each payer_plan_period record. This is obtained from the mem_eff_from_date in the STARR Common shc_payors and lpch_payors tables.</td>

<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#payer_plan_period">PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD</a></td>

<td class="dd-mono">payer_plan_period_end_date</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">DATE</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#payer_plan_period">PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">payer_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the standard concept_id in the concept table. Upon mapping payer_concept_id to the standard concept_id in the concept table, this field represents the entity that would reimburse billable services for any provider(s) administering care to the person in each payer_plan_period record. It contains the standard concept obtained after mapping the qrda_sop_code_c field from STARR Common shc_payors and lpch_payors tables to the concept_code field in the concept table. The concept domain is &#x27;Payer&#x27; and the vocabulary is &#x27;SOPT&#x27;.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#payer_plan_period">PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">payer_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>Payer information as it appears in the source data. The value is represented as an array containing the fin_class_name, qrda_sopt_code_c, and sop_code_name values from the STARR Common shc_payors and lpch_payors tables.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#payer_plan_period">PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">payer_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#concept">CONCEPT</a></td>
<td>A foreign key identifier to the source concept_id in the concept table. This field represents the entity that would reimburse billable services for any provider(s) administering care to the person in each payer_plan_period record, as it appears in the source data. It contains the source concept obtained after mapping the qrda_sop_code_c field from STARR Common shc_payors and lpch_payors tables to the concept_code field in the concept table. The concept domain is &#x27;Payer&#x27; and the vocabulary is &#x27;SOPT&#x27;.</td>
</tr>

<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>

The value is represented as an array containing the benefit_plan_id and benefit_plan_name values from the STARR Common shc_payors and lpch_payors tables.</td>

<td class="dd-mono">plan_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>

</tr>

</tr>

<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#payer_plan_period">PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD</a></td>

<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#visit_detail">VISIT_DETAIL</a></td>
<td>The VISIT_DETAIL record during which the Procedure occurred. For example, if the Person was in the ICU at the time of the Procedure the VISIT_OCCURRENCE record would reflect the overall hospital stay and the VISIT_DETAIL record would reflect the ICU stay during the hospital visit. Currently it is not populated for this table</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#procedure_occurrence">PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">procedure_source_value</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">STRING</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>this is the source value as it appears in the source data. Includes a JSON string with the provenance of the data that includes names and codes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="dd-mono"><a href="#procedure_occurrence">PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE</a></td>
<td>Core CDM</td>
<td class="dd-mono">procedure_source_concept_id</td>
<td class="dd-align-center">No</td>
<td class="dd-mono">INT64</td>
<td class="dd-mono"></td>
<td>This is the concept representing the procedure source value and may not necessarily be standard. This field is discouraged from use in analysis because it is not required to contain Standard Concepts that are used across the OHDSI community, and should only be used when Standard Concepts do not adequately represent the source detail for the Procedure necessary for a given analytic use case. Consider using PROCEDURE_CONCEPT_ID instead to enable standardized analytics that can be consistent across the network.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
